title: nf-core/molkart pipeline parameters
description: An analysis pipeline for Molecular Cartography data from Resolve Biosciences.

segmentation_methods_and_options.title: Segmentation Method Selection
segmentation_methods_and_options.description: Define which segmentation method should be used.

segmentation_method.title: Segmentation Method
segmentation_method.description:
Select the primary segmentation method. 
- **mesmer**: Utilizes DeepCell Mesmer for whole-cell or nuclear segmentation. Good for complex morphologies. 
- **cellpose**: Employs the Cellpose algorithm, versatile for various cell types. Can use pre-trained models or custom ones. 
- **stardist**: Uses StarDist, a deep learning method effective for star-convex shaped objects, particularly nuclei. 
- **ilastik**: Leverages Ilastik for pixel classification and segmentation.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment.
input.help_text: You will need to create a design file with information about the samples in your experiment before running the pipeline. Use this parameter to specify its location. It has to be a comma-separated file with 3 columns, and a header row. See [usage docs](https://nf-co.re/molkart/usage#samplesheet-input).

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.
